# Ingestion Pipeline Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Validate requirement completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and edge-case coverage for the recursive PDF ingestion pipeline, hierarchical chunker, vector store, and document metadata tracking before task implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Object Storage Discovery & File Filtering Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Is the recursive traversal behavior explicitly specified for arbitrary directory depths in object storage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]
- [x] CHK002 - Are filtering requirements unambiguous regarding case-sensitivity and handling of non-PDF extensions (e.g., `.PDF`, `.txt`, `.docx`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the fallback behavior clearly defined when a caller provides a directory path prefix without an explicit bucket name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification define expected behavior when the target storage directory is empty or contains zero PDF files? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §User Story 1]

---

## 2. Document Lifecycle Classification & State Tracking Requirements

- [x] CHK005 - Are the exact criteria and timestamp comparison rules for classifying documents as `created`, `updated`, `deleted`, or `unchanged` unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §4.1]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the requirement to preserve a stable `document_id` across file revisions explicitly mandated and consistent between the spec and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §2.2]
- [x] CHK007 - Are directory-scoped deletion detection rules specified for documents previously recorded in the database but absent from the current storage scan? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §4.1]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the behavior and execution skipping rule for `unchanged` files explicitly defined without redundant parsing or vector modification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Acceptance Scenario 1.4]

---

## 3. Sequential PDF Parsing & Markdown Conversion Requirements

- [x] CHK009 - Is the "one at a time" sequential processing requirement explicitly specified to bound worker memory consumption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 - Are heading retention and markdown formatting expectations defined for the PDF-to-Markdown conversion engine? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Research §1]
- [x] CHK011 - Are object storage naming patterns and bucket destinations specified for generated Markdown artifacts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Storage-Records]
- [x] CHK012 - Are failure requirements explicitly documented for scanned or image-only PDFs lacking extractable digital text layers? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the specification define error containment rules ensuring that corrupted or password-protected PDFs do not abort the overall execution run? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 4. Hierarchical Chunking & Metadata Preservation Requirements

- [x] CHK014 - Are Markdown header boundary rules (H1, H2, H3) specified as strict, hard partitioning barriers that prevent text mixing across headers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the length threshold (maximum 1,000 characters) and overlap size (100 characters) quantified with exact measurement units? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the restriction of the 100-character overlap strictly to subdivided sections (never crossing header boundaries) explicitly mandated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 - Are all required chunk metadata attributes (`chunk_id`, `document_id`, `source_file_name`, `storage_path`, `chunk_index`, `total_chunks`, `h1`, `h2`, `h3`) completely specified with data types and nullability rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §3.3]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the fallback behavior defined for documents lacking any headings or containing text prior to the first heading? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK019 - Are handling requirements documented for deeply nested headings beyond Header 3 (e.g., H4, H5)? [Edge Case, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 5. Vector Embedding & Qdrant Synchronization Requirements

- [x] CHK020 - Is the embedding model (`gemini-embedding-001`) and expected vector dimension (768) explicitly specified in the contracts and settings? [Clarity, Contract §Storage-Records, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK021 - Are deletion filter requirements specified to purge all obsolete chunk vectors by `document_id` when a document is updated or deleted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Research §2]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the distance metric (Cosine) and collection configuration explicitly documented for the Qdrant vector collection? [Clarity, Contract §Storage-Records, Research §2]
- [x] CHK023 - Are batching parameters or rate-limit retry requirements defined for embedding generation? [Gap, Contract §Pipeline-Contract]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements documented for the complete purge and recreation of the vector collection when `reset_on_start` is triggered? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Pipeline-Contract]

---

## 6. MongoDB Metadata Storage & State Persistence Requirements

- [x] CHK025 - Are schema fields, types, and required constraints fully specified for both `executions` and `documents` MongoDB collections? [Completeness, Data Model §3.1, Data Model §3.2, Contract §Storage-Records]
- [x] CHK026 - Are unique index requirements on `(bucket, storage_path)` and `execution_id` documented to prevent duplicate document tracking? [Consistency, Contract §Storage-Records, Data Model §1]
- [x] CHK027 - Are execution milestone counters (`discovered_count`, `created_count`, `updated_count`, `deleted_count`, `unchanged_count`, `failed_count`) defined with non-negative constraints? [Measurability, Data Model §3.1]
- [x] CHK028 - Are state cleanup and collection drop requirements specified for MongoDB when `reset_on_start` is active? [Completeness, Contract §Pipeline-Contract, Plan §Summary]

---

## 7. Observability, Contextual Logging & Error Isolation Requirements

- [x] CHK029 - Does the specification mandate structured contextual logging via Loguru with explicit required attributes (`execution_id`, `document_id`, `chunk_id`, `storage_path`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §VI]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the prohibition of standard library logging and raw `print()` statements documented as a non-negotiable review gate? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §VI]
- [x] CHK031 - Are document-isolated error logging and state transition requirements specified for downstream failure reporting without masking stack traces? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Pipeline-Contract]
- [x] CHK032 - Are overall execution terminal states (`completed`, `completed_with_errors`, `failed`) defined with unambiguous transition criteria? [Clarity, Data Model §2.1, Contract §Pipeline-Contract]

## 8. Constitutional Compliance & Configuration Governance

- [x] CHK033 - Is GCP Vertex AI access explicitly mandated via environment variable API key authentication rather than ambient or machine credentials? [Security, Constitution §II, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK034 - Are unmocked, end-to-end integration tests using real Docker Compose containers (MinIO, MongoDB, Qdrant) mandated as the primary verification strategy? [Traceability, Constitution §III, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK035 - Are human-only ownership constraints over `.notes/`, `design.excalidraw.png`, and git commits validated as strict out-of-scope boundaries? [Governance, Constitution §Governance, Plan §Constitution Check]
